title: A Leader that runs elect() trips the leader_handler vote-order assertion (transfer to the current leader)
cause: Engine::elect() on a node that is already Leader keeps its Leader object while moving the local vote to a higher non-committed vote; Engine::leader_handler() debug-asserts leader.committed_vote >= state.vote and RaftCore calls it every loop iteration.
trigger: Call Raft::transfer_leader(leader_vote, current_leader_id, ..) (new) or Raft::trigger().elect() on the leader (pre-existing).
consequence: With debug assertions enabled the leader's RaftCore panics (Fatal::Panicked) and the cluster loses its leader until an election timeout; release-build behavior not verified.
premises: Builds with debug assertions (openraft's test configuration).
Neither the TransferLeader handler nor ExternalCommand::Elect rejects elect() on a Leader.
